messages.author: d5124cd091a46db4
messages.subject: dplyr: filtering by na
parts:
Suppose I have this data-frame

dta <- data.frame(observation = 1:20,
                  valueA = runif(n = 20),
                  valueB = runif(n = 20),
                  valueC = runif(n = 20),
                  valueD = runif(n = 20))
dta[2:5,3] <- NA
dta[2:10,4] <- NA
dta[7:20,5] <- NA

How can I find which rows have valueB==NA and valueC==NA ?
 
dta%>%filter(valueB==NA, valueC==NA)
gives me: 
Error: incorrect length (0), expecting: 20

Thanks,

Avner

messages.subject: Re: [Israel RUG] dplyr: filtering by na
parts:
try the %in% operator
x = c(1,NA,3)
x[! x %in% NA]   # removes NA
x[! x %in% 1]      # removes 1's

messages.subject: Re: [Israel RUG] dplyr: filtering by na
